title: Save a threatened piece
objective: Move an attacked knight to safety and notice the next attack on your rook.

commentary_source.name: Uroschess original practice lesson
commentary_source.attribution: Original practice position and teaching text; not a historical game

steps.explanation: The bishop on h6 attacks your knight on d2 along the diagonal through g5, f4, and e3. Move the knight to f3, outside that diagonal.

question.prompt: Move your knight from d2 to f3.
hints: Knights can jump over other pieces.

tree.feedback: Nf3 escapes the bishop's diagonal safely.
Ra2 moves the rook, but leaves the knight on d2 available for Bxd2. Save the knight first.

steps.explanation: Black moved the bishop to g7. Now its long diagonal reaches your rook on a1. Notice the new target and move that rook to safety.

question.prompt: Move your rook off the bishop's diagonal.
hints: The rook on a1 is the piece under attack.
Moving the rook from a1 to a2 is one safe choice.
